Name: ClockOnlyFreeze
Author: belite00001
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]Clock Only Freeze is a lightweight, host-controlled time management mod for Stardew Valley 1.6.
It lets the host stop only the in-game clock without pausing the rest of the world. Players can continue moving, fighting, placing items, and interacting normally while monsters, machines, buffs, and debuffs continue to update.
The mod also provides simple fast-forward controls for players who want more control over the pace of the day.[/color]

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]Vortex[/color]

[list=1]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Download the main file using Mod Manager Download.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Enable the mod in Vortex.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Select [b]Deploy Mods[/b].[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Launch Stardew Valley through SMAPI.[/color][/*]
[/list][color=#D4D4D8][b][size=4]Manual installation[/size][/b][/color]

[list=1]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Install SMAPI.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Download and extract the mod.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Place the[/color]

[code]ClockOnlyFreeze[/code][color=#D4D4D8]folder inside your Stardew Valley[/color]

[code]Mods[/code][color=#D4D4D8]folder.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Launch the game through SMAPI.[/color][/*]
[/list][color=#D4D4D8]For multiplayer, the host must install the mod and controls all time operations.
Please disable other mods that pause, freeze, rewind, or change the speed of the game clock, as using multiple time-control mods together may cause conflicts.[/color]

[size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Freeze only the in-game clock while the world remains active.[/*]
[*]Players, monsters, combat, tools, and item placement continue functioning.[/*]
[*]Placed machines continue processing while the clock is frozen.[/*]
[*]Food, drink, buff, and debuff durations continue counting down normally.[/*]
[*]Host-controlled 2× and 4× fast-forward modes.[/*]
[*]Emergency key to immediately return to normal speed.[/*]
[*]Automatically returns fast-forward to normal speed at 1:00 AM by default.[/*]
[*]Configurable key bindings through Generic Mod Config Menu.[/*]
[*]Short HUD messages show the currently selected time mode.[/*]
[*]Does not add custom data to save files and can be removed safely.[/*]
[/list]Default controls
[list]
[*]F7
— Freeze or resume the clock[/*]
[*]F8
— Cycle through normal, 2×, and 4× speed[/*]
[*]F9
— Immediately return to normal speed[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]Required[/color]

[list]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Stardew Valley 1.6[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]SMAPI 4.1.0 or later[/color][/*]
[/list][color=#D4D4D8]Optional[/color]

[list]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Generic Mod Config Menu
Allows the three control keys to be changed through the in-game [b]Mod Options[/b] menu.[/color][/*]
[/list][color=#D4D4D8]No other framework mods are required.[/color]

[size=4][b]Shout outs[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]This mod was created by the author with assistance from a trusted AI assistant.
AI was used to help generate and revise the C# code and documentation. The author designed the intended behavior, tested each build in-game, identified bugs, and guided the implementation through repeated testing and refinement.
Special thanks to ConcernedApe for Stardew Valley, Pathoschild and the SMAPI contributors, and spacechase0 for Generic Mod Config Menu.[/color]
